name: Ringg AI
target_customer: Enterprises and operations teams, including healthcare
pricing: ₹6/connected min; ₹499/number/mo; WhatsApp ₹2/5-minute session
setup_effort: Medium: self-serve builder plus workflow integration
notable_customers_or_reviews: Practo: 1000+ daily appointments and 85% first-call resolution claimed
strengths_vs_avery: Strong Indic voice, transparent India rate, proven Practo deployment
weaknesses_vs_avery: Requires clinic-specific build and operations; not a packaged single-clinic front desk

name: Bolna AI
hindi_hinglish: Hindi, Hinglish and 10+ vernacular languages claimed
pricing: ₹5.52/min standard bundled rate; docs also describe $0.02/min platform fee plus chosen provider and telephony costs
notable_customers_or_reviews: Awign, Futwork and GoKwik testimonials on pricing page
strengths_vs_avery: Low public starting rate and broad Indian-language support
weaknesses_vs_avery: No packaged clinic workflow, WhatsApp follow-up or Google Calendar setup

name: Exotel (AI voicebot)
pricing: Quote-only; public page lists no per-minute AI rate (Sep 2026 per third party)
strengths_vs_avery: Owns Indian telephony + numbers; Avery runs on Exotel too
weaknesses_vs_avery: Carrier, not a clinic product; could become a channel partner rather than a rival

name: Pluxo
category: Indian AI front desk for clinics
hindi_hinglish: Hindi plus 10 other Indian languages; switches languages per vendor
pricing: Core ₹2999/mo + GST incl. 250 AI-call min and unlimited WhatsApp; extra minutes ₹5.50–₹7.50
notable_customers_or_reviews: EQUA obesity centre named in vendor case material
strengths_vs_avery: Direct clinic fit, 11 languages, recalls, no-show recovery and transparent price
weaknesses_vs_avery: DPDP evidence and external calendar/PMS integrations not clearly documented publicly

name: Practo (Ray / Connect)
category: Indian clinic software and call management
hindi_hinglish: Ray language support unknown; Ringg voice AI used on Practo booking lines
pricing: Ray Connect: ₹999–₹1499/mo for 1000 credits or ₹1999–₹2499/mo for 4000 credits depending term
price_basis_for_600_min_month_inr: ₹999–₹2499 for call management; not AI reception
notable_customers_or_reviews: Large clinic install base; Ringg case study claims 1000+ daily bookings
strengths_vs_avery: Owns clinic workflow, patient marketplace and call-management relationship
weaknesses_vs_avery: No verified AI receptionist sold to a single clinic on its own line; complement rather than replacement

name: Clinicia
pricing: Standard ₹7000/year; Premium ₹8500/year
setup_effort: Low; instant setup under 5 minutes claimed
strengths_vs_avery: Low-cost EMR, calendar and patient communications
weaknesses_vs_avery: No AI call answering; complement to Avery

name: Eka Care (Eka for Doctors)
channels: WhatsApp schedule management and messaging add-ons
pricing: Doc Plus ₹16999/year offer; Doc Pro ₹18749/year; Clinic Pro ₹100000/year; WhatsApp-own-number add-on ₹24999/year
notable_customers_or_reviews: 10000+ doctors claimed on vendor pricing archive
strengths_vs_avery: ABDM-oriented clinic workflow and paid WhatsApp options
weaknesses_vs_avery: No AI voice answering

name: AiSensy
hindi_hinglish: Template or AI text can use configured languages
pricing: Basic ₹1500/mo; Pro ₹3200/mo; AI Agent ₹1350/mo; chatbot flows ₹2500/mo; message fees extra
strengths_vs_avery: Low entry price, WhatsApp automation and broadcasts
weaknesses_vs_avery: Does not answer phone calls

name: Interakt (Haptik)
pricing: Growth ₹2799–₹2999/mo; Advanced ₹3799/mo; AI agents add-on from ₹2499/mo; + message fees + 18% GST
strengths_vs_avery: Brand trust; AI agents on WhatsApp
weaknesses_vs_avery: No phone answering

name: WATI
pricing: Growth ₹2499–₹2999/mo; Pro ₹5999–₹6499/mo; Business ₹16999–₹18499/mo (third-party, Aug–Nov 2026); $59/$119 USD tiers
strengths_vs_avery: Polished shared inbox; widely used
weaknesses_vs_avery: No phone answering

name: Smith.ai
hindi_hinglish: English and Spanish; Hindi not found
pricing: Free 25 calls; Pro from $150/75 calls; Enterprise $500/300 calls
notable_customers_or_reviews: 5000+ businesses and named law-firm reviews claimed
strengths_vs_avery: Human escalation and strong US service brand
weaknesses_vs_avery: No verified India numbers, Hindi/Hinglish, WhatsApp or INR billing

name: Rosie
pricing: Professional $49/250 min; Scale $149/1000 min; Growth $299/2000 min; $0.25/min overage (conflicting older snapshot: $99/500, $199/1000)
strengths_vs_avery: Very fast self-serve setup
weaknesses_vs_avery: US-only numbers; no Hindi/WhatsApp

name: Goodcall
pricing: Starter $79/100 unique customers; Growth $129/500; Scale $299/2000
strengths_vs_avery: Predictable billing by unique caller and included number
weaknesses_vs_avery: US-focused; no verified Hindi, WhatsApp or India number

name: My AI Front Desk (Frontdesk)
pricing: Business-in-a-Box $99/mo ($79 annual) incl. 200 min; $0.25/min after; SMS 4¢
strengths_vs_avery: White-label program = agencies could resell into India
weaknesses_vs_avery: USD pricing ~3.4x Avery for typical clinic; no WhatsApp

name: Arini
pricing: Quote-only; one guide cites $200–$700/mo (unsourced)
strengths_vs_avery: Deep dental PMS integration – the model to copy
weaknesses_vs_avery: US-only; no Hindi/WhatsApp

name: Sully.ai
pricing: Quote-only (pricing discussed after demo)
strengths_vs_avery: Full clinical agent suite (scribe, nurse, receptionist)
weaknesses_vs_avery: Enterprise US healthcare; irrelevant to Indian dental SMB

name: Retell AI
pricing: $0.07–$0.31/min; $2/number/mo; telephony and add-ons vary
setup_effort: High unless an agency manages it
strengths_vs_avery: Mature testing, integrations and strong voice platform
weaknesses_vs_avery: DIY clinic workflow; Indian carrier, WhatsApp, DPDP and support must be assembled

name: Vapi
pricing: $0.05/min Vapi fee plus transcriber, model, voice and telephony; $2/number/mo
price_basis_for_600_min_month_inr: At least ₹2822 platform fee for 600 min plus all providers and build
strengths_vs_avery: Flexible provider choice and agency ecosystem
weaknesses_vs_avery: Total cost and clinic operations are fragmented; no packaged Indian WhatsApp workflow

name: Bland AI
pricing: Start $0.14/min; Build $299/mo + $0.12/min; Scale $499/mo + $0.11/min; carrier cost separate
strengths_vs_avery: All-inclusive AI rate and high concurrency
weaknesses_vs_avery: DIY clinic workflow; India language and WhatsApp fit unknown

name: Synthflow
pricing: Reported enterprise minimum $30000/yr from Jun 2026; ~$0.11–$0.13/min (sources conflict on self-serve Starter)
strengths_vs_avery: No-code builder
weaknesses_vs_avery: Moved upmarket – irrelevant for single clinics
